notes: «قال: سمعت الصادق جعفر بن محمد (عليه السلام) يقول»: Harun heard the Imam, so the Imam is the last link (rule 5 and owner ruling 2). The surface is copied as written; the honorific is out.
«(4)» and «(1)» are footnote marks in the text, left out.
